claims.label: Host Says Terryl Accessed an SD Card on His Laptop at the Crime Scene
claims.claim: The host says the episode footage looks very much like Terryl Farnsworth inserting an SD card into his laptop and accessing it within approximately 10 minutes of Charlie Kirk being hit.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original raw footage and forensic metadata to confirm SD-card insertion sequence; cross-reference with David Hull testimony on chain of custody.

claims.label: Host Says Footage Shows Terryl Showing Laptop Content to Philip Goldsberry Shortly After the Shooting
claims.claim: The host says the episode footage shows Terryl Farnsworth displaying content on his laptop screen to Philip Goldsberry approximately 10 minutes after Charlie Kirk was hit.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and interview Philip Goldsberry regarding the content shown; obtain his contemporaneous account.

claims.label: In Clip Host Plays, Ana Kasparian Says Terryl Never Provided the Original SD Card to Investigators
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Ana Kasparian says, based on preliminary-hearing testimony, that Terryl Farnsworth did not provide the original SD card to investigators, only Google links and a flash drive.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm SD-card disposition against official evidence logs; subpoena physical media if it exists.

claims.label: Host Says Lead Investigator David Hull Did Not Receive the SD Cards
claims.claim: The host says lead investigator David Hull, who she says did not receive the SD cards, informed the preliminary hearing of the chain of custody.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the preliminary-hearing transcript and confirm testimony verbatim.

claims.label: Host Says Hearing Testimony Named the Utah County Attorney's Office as Maker of the Sizzle Reel
claims.claim: The host says a witness at the preliminary hearing testified that the Utah County Attorney's Office created the 20-minute sizzle reel, and in a clip she plays the witness says he did not prepare the video compilation and that the Utah County Attorney's Office did.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Bricker's full preliminary-hearing testimony; request the prosecution's production logs and version history for the sizzle reel.

claims.label: Host Says the 20-Minute Sizzle Reel Has a Decreased (Modified) Aspect Ratio
claims.claim: The host says the aspect ratio of the 20-minute sizzle reel shown at the preliminary hearing was decreased relative to the source footage, and she demonstrates this on the episode at normal speed and in slow motion.
claims.investigative_direction: Have a forensic video analyst compare the sizzle reel against raw UVU surveillance footage to quantify the aspect-ratio shift.

claims.label: Anonymous federal-court employee stated federal courts do not alter video evidence
claims.claim: Per an email from an anonymous federal-court employee read on air, video and photo evidence is never altered in any federal court the employee has worked in, because alteration would prejudice the jury.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the email's authenticity through metadata; corroborate with court policy documentation. Treat as anonymous-source claim pending verification.

claims.label: Host Says the Prosecution or Possibly the FBI, Not Likely the Court, Decreased the Aspect Ratio
claims.claim: The host says the prosecution (Utah County Attorney's Office) potentially decreased the aspect ratio, that maybe it was the FBI, that somebody did, and that an emailer told her it was highly unlikely the court did it.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace the production chain of the sizzle reel through prosecution discovery logs; identify all parties with custody between raw footage and exhibit.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet claimed Candace conceded the debate
claims.claim: On the Kolvet/Neff podcast, Andrew Kolvet stated that Candace conceded the debate early and repeatedly and predicted the loss would "age well" for him.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare this characterization to a transcript of the debate Candace participated in; identify specific concessions alleged.

claims.label: Andrew Wilson defended Candace on the Hitler-clip interpretation
claims.claim: On the Kolvet/Neff podcast, Andrew Wilson said that after reviewing the clip it seemed to him Candace was making a comparison to nationalism rather than apologetics for Hitler, and he pushed back on Andrew Kolvet's framing.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Candace clip being referenced; transcribe the full segment in context.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk stated in November 2023 that Candace is "on our team"
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays and dates to November 2023, Charlie Kirk says Candace is "on our team" and that he told a critic asking about her AmFest appearance to "lose my number."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited segment; note any surrounding context that may complicate the read.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet briefed Candace on Bill Ackman summit, BB Netanyahu letter, and Charlie's texts to Dan Flood
claims.claim: The host says that in phone conversations around September 12-14, 2025, Andrew Kolvet told her about the Bill Ackman summit, Benjamin Netanyahu's letter, and Charlie Kirk's text messages to Dan Flood and Kolvet the night before; she shows a call log and text messages.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve the original text-message exports with metadata; obtain contemporaneous corroboration from other TPUSA insiders if available.

claims.label: Bill Ackman is the 'Bill Ackman' of the summit named in C-12428 (revises C-12428)
claims.claim: C-12428 spells the summit host 'Bill Ackman' (auto-caption form). The person is Bill Ackman (N-37): the host says Andrew Kolvet was the one telling her about the Bill Ackman summit on September 12, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Read with C-12428; match the text-message exports under the corrected spelling Bill Ackman.
claims.transcript_snippet: on the 12th, you were the one that was telling me about the Bill Ackman summit.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Told Her on September 14, 2025 That the TPUSA Board Had Voted In Erika Kirk
claims.claim: The host says that on September 14, 2025 Andrew Kolvet told her the TPUSA board had already voted in Erika Kirk, said not to say it yet, and that it was not being announced publicly.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with TPUSA corporate filings, board minutes, and Erika Kirk's public statements around the leadership transition.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Debate Guest Wilson Was Debated Last Friday
claims.claim: The host says she debated Andrew Wilson last Friday and that Andrew Kolvet then had Wilson on the Kolvet and Blake Neff show.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the debate date and the Kolvet/Neff episode air date from the platforms' upload records.
claims.transcript_snippet: He brought on Andrew Wilson, who I debated last Friday, onto their Beus and Butudad platform.

claims.label: Host Says Journalists Work With Influencers to Imply She Is the Assassin
claims.claim: The host alleges that journalists are working with a ring of influencers to insert stories implying she is the true assassin of Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific published stories and any communications between those journalists and the influencers; this rests on the host's characterization.
claims.transcript_snippet: the journalists working with them to insert stories about me implying that I'm the true assassin of Charlie Kirk.

claims.label: Host Recalls Kolvet Said Terryl Worried About Hat Thieves
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet told the audience that Terryl Farnsworth removed the camera card because he was worried about people stealing hats, which she says does not fit the footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Kolvet's original on-air statement about hats and compare it with Farnsworth's own explanation to the host.
claims.transcript_snippet: we were told by Andrew Kolvet that he was worried about people stealing hats.

claims.label: Host Says She Interviewed With Ana Kasparian the Day Before
claims.claim: The host says she joined Ana Kasparian's program for an interview the day before this episode, where Kasparian asked about the SD card.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Kasparian interview upload and confirm its date and the question asked.
claims.transcript_snippet: yesterday I joined Ana Kasparian on her program uh for an interview

claims.label: Host Cites Utah Definition of Evidence Tampering
claims.claim: The host says the Utah code defines tampering with evidence as altering, destroying, concealing or removing an item with the purpose of impairing its veracity or availability in a proceeding or investigation, and that this could be charged as a felony in Utah.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the quoted wording against the current Utah evidence-tampering statute and its felony grading.
claims.transcript_snippet: altering, destroying, concealing, or removing a thing or item with the purpose of impairing its veracity or availability of the thing or item in the proceeding or investigation.

claims.label: Host Says Prosecution Inferred From Videos at Preliminary Hearing
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk's prosecution team at the preliminary hearing looked at videos and inferred what it believed it saw, and that she is doing the same with the footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the preliminary hearing transcript for how the prosecution described video evidence.
claims.transcript_snippet: We're doing what Erika's prosecution did um her prosecution team did at the preliminary hearing, looking at the videos and inferring upon what we believe we see.

claims.label: Host Says It Is Undisputed Terryl Removed a Physical Object
claims.claim: The host says it is not in dispute that Terryl Farnsworth removed a physical object from the crime scene and then went behind the tent and put it in his pocket.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm against the host's earlier footage and any statement by Farnsworth or investigators.
claims.transcript_snippet: What is not in dispute is that Terryl did in fact remove a physical object from the crime scene.

claims.label: Host Says Footage Was Zoomed In When Given to Her Nine Days Later
claims.claim: The host says the footage Terryl Farnsworth presented to her nine days after the shooting had already been zoomed in, though she says she does not know whether he zoomed in the camera footage and sent a Google link to the SBI.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original back-camera file with metadata and compare it with the version the host received.
claims.transcript_snippet: What we can say for certain is that he had zoomed in by the time he presented it to me nine nine days later.

claims.label: Host Says Hull Placed Lead Investigators on Scene Around 1:30
claims.claim: The host says David Hull testified, as she believes he said, that the lead investigators arrived on the scene around 1:30.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the preliminary hearing transcript for Hull's stated arrival time.
claims.transcript_snippet: who were on the scene, who arrived on the scene around 1:30, I believe he said.

claims.label: Host Says Terryl Declared Charlie Dead in a Selfie Video
claims.claim: The host says Terryl Farnsworth declared in a selfie video that Charlie Kirk was dead within about two minutes of the shooting, which she uses to argue he knew it was a crime scene.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the selfie video and its metadata for the time and wording of the declaration.
claims.transcript_snippet: he declared, you'll recall in a selfie video, that Charlie was dead.

claims.label: Host Says Terryl's Selfie Video Metadata Runs to Just After 12:26
claims.claim: The host says metadata on Terryl Farnsworth's self-recorded video shows he filmed himself until just after 12:26, with Charlie Kirk struck at 12:23.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original file Farnsworth sent the host and verify embedded creation and end times.
claims.transcript_snippet: Terl was filming himself until just after 12:26. So Charlie gets hit at 12 23 and Terl is filming himself until 12:26 and 16 milliseconds.

claims.label: Host Says Terryl Began Taking the Camera Down Around 12:28
claims.claim: The host says it was almost precisely 12:28 when Terryl Farnsworth began taking the camera down, leaving about a minute and a half for any officer to tell him to secure the footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Frame-date the footage of the camera removal against the corroborated shooting time.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's around almost precisely 12:28 that he begins taking the camera down.

claims.label: Host Says Police Instruction Is Hardly Possible in the Time Window
claims.claim: The host says it is hardly possible that law enforcement officers on the scene told Terryl Farnsworth to secure the footage, given the metadata timeline.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask investigators whether any officer instructed Farnsworth, and obtain body-camera logs from the first minutes.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's hardly possible that law enforcement officers on the scene told him to secure the footage

claims.label: Host Rules Out Allan Robertson as Having Told Terryl
claims.claim: The host says Allan Robertson can be ruled out as the one who told Terryl to get the footage: she says he was visiting from Utah State University, undercover to check protesters, and would not have known who Terryl was.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Robertson's role and location from USU police records and the host's earlier reporting.
claims.transcript_snippet: Allan Robertson, we determined, was just visiting from Utah State University. He was undercover because he was there to check out the protesters ahead of the event.

claims.label: Host Says She Was Told Terryl Was Told the Opposite
claims.claim: The host says she was told, allegedly, that Terryl Farnsworth was told to do the exact opposite and not disturb the crime scene.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the host's source and any witness who gave Farnsworth that instruction.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I was told, and I will say allegedly here, that actually Terryl was told to do the exact opposite.

claims.label: Host Says Terryl Never Claimed Police Told Him
claims.claim: The host says Terryl Farnsworth never claimed police told him to take the footage and that this narrative came only from Tyler Bowyer.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Bowyer's public statements with Farnsworth's account to the host.
claims.transcript_snippet: this narrative uh of the police told him to do that. Terryl himself never made that claim.

claims.label: Host Says Terryl Named Only Erika as Someone He Spoke To
claims.claim: The host says the only person Terryl Farnsworth mentioned speaking to was Erika Kirk, without saying when, and that she is not suggesting Erika directed him.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Farnsworth and Erika Kirk about the timing and content of that conversation.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm just asserting that factually the only person that he mentioned to me that he spoke to was Erika.

claims.label: Host Says Terryl Said He Wanted to Spare Erika Seeing Charlie Die in 4K
claims.claim: The host says her understanding was that Terryl Farnsworth acted on his own volition because he did not want Erika Kirk to have to see Charlie Kirk die in 4K.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Farnsworth's own statement of motive and compare it with the police-instruction and hat explanations.
claims.transcript_snippet: he did not want Erika to have to see Charlie die in 4K.

claims.label: Host Lists Three Conflicting Explanations for Taking the Footage
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Bowyer said police told Terryl, Terryl said he acted on his own volition to protect Erika, and Andrew Kolvet said it was about hat thieves.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect each explanation with date and venue and ask TPUSA to reconcile them.
claims.transcript_snippet: You had Tyler saying the police said it. You had Terryl saying that he did it out of his own valition to protect Erika.

claims.label: Host Says Maroon Man in Court Footage Looks Wider Than Tyler Robinson
claims.claim: The host says the maroon-shirted man in the 4K court footage looks a lot wider than Tyler Robinson and that influencers shown it failed to mention this.
claims.investigative_direction: Measure the figure's proportions in unaltered footage against Robinson's known dimensions.
claims.transcript_snippet: this guy looks to be wider, a lot wider than Tyler Robinson.

claims.label: Host Says Emailer Corrected Compressed to Aspect Ratio Decreased
claims.claim: The host says an email told her the technically correct description of what was done to the court footage is that its aspect ratio was decreased, not that it was compressed.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the emailer's expertise and check the description against the exhibit file properties.
claims.transcript_snippet: the correct way to describe this what was done to the footage is not to say that it was uh compressed.

claims.label: Host Says Her Government Source Confirmed the Footage Was Modified
claims.claim: The host says the footage shown in court was in effect modified and that her government source confirmed it.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek the court exhibit original and ask the source on record, or a second source, to confirm.
claims.transcript_snippet: The footage that you saw in court that I saw in court was in effect modified. My government source confirmed that.

claims.label: Host Denies Using AI After a Lawyer Accused Her
claims.claim: The host says an online Canadian lawyer claimed she used AI and was lying about the footage, and that she did not use AI.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the lawyer's posts and compare the host's slowed and normal-speed footage with the court exhibit.
claims.transcript_snippet: I go online and I have that unhinged Canadian lawyer claiming that I used AI, claiming that I'm lying

claims.label: Host Says Hull Testified Bricker Gathered All UVU Surveillance
claims.claim: The host says David Hull testified that on September 10 Sergeant Mark Bricker of the SBI was put in charge of gathering all of the surveillance on campus at UVU.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the preliminary hearing transcript for Hull's chain-of-custody testimony on surveillance collection.
claims.transcript_snippet: Sergeant Mark Bricker of the SBI was put in charge of gathering all of the surveillance on campus at UVU.

claims.label: Wilson Says Hundreds of DMs Called the Steakhouse Receipt a Fraud
claims.claim: Andrew Wilson says on the Kolvet/Neff show that he received hundreds of DMs from people who did not know the steakhouse receipt was a complete phony fraud.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish what evidence Wilson relies on for calling the receipt fraudulent.
claims.transcript_snippet: I got hundreds of DMs, for instance, from people who didn't know that the steakhouse receipt was a complete phony fraud

claims.label: Podcast Speaker Relays Burkhart: Defense Would Present Exculpatory Evidence
claims.claim: A speaker on the Kolvet/Neff show, apparently Kolvet, says Andrea Burkhart told him a defense with exculpatory evidence such as a steakhouse receipt would present it at the preliminary hearing.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Birkhart on record and compare with the defense's stated reasons for not presenting evidence at the hearing.
claims.transcript_snippet: If they had exculpatory evidence, whether it's the parents that actually, you know, think he's innocent or they have some steakhouse receipt, would they not present that at the preliminary hearing?

claims.label: Host Says the FBI Took a Statement From the Restaurant Owner
claims.claim: The host says the FBI is aware of the steakhouse receipt and took a statement from the restaurant owner (transcribed as 'Odor').
claims.investigative_direction: Request confirmation from the FBI or the owner that a statement was taken, and when.
claims.transcript_snippet: The FBI is aware of this. The FBI took a statement from the Odor.

claims.label: Host Says She Spoke to the Steakhouse Owner
claims.claim: The host says she spoke to the owner of the restaurant and that this undercuts claims that the receipt story is fabricated.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the owner's own on-record account of the call with the host and the receipt.
claims.transcript_snippet: I know that this completely blows up everything and that's why you guys are trying to convince the public that this is a this didn't happen, but I spoke to the owner.

claims.label: Host Says the Server Has Given an Interview and a Receipt Exists
claims.claim: The host says the server has given an interview and that there is a receipt.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the server's interview and obtain the receipt record from the restaurant.
claims.transcript_snippet: Uh the server has been has given an interview. There is a receipt.

claims.label: Host Says Defense Reported Missing Discovery at the April Hearing
claims.claim: The host says that at the April hearing the defense kept saying it had not been granted discovery and wanted an extension on the preliminary hearing to go through material.
claims.investigative_direction: Check April hearing records for the defense's discovery complaints and extension request.
claims.transcript_snippet: back during the one in April, they kept saying that they did not get granted discovery that they had so many things that they needed to go through

claims.label: Host Says Podcasters Found the Receipt and the FBI Was Contacted
claims.claim: The host says the receipt was found by podcasters who stumbled on it while investigating, and that the FBI was contacted.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the podcasters and the FBI report or contact record.
claims.transcript_snippet: Podcasters who were investigating stumbled upon this and like I said, the FBI was contacted.

claims.label: Host Says the Meal Was Paid by Debit Card and the Owner Pulled the Receipt
claims.claim: The host says the restaurant owner pulled the receipt, that it shows what the person ate, and that it was paid for on a debit card.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the receipt and card-issuer record under legal process, and confirm the cardholder.
claims.transcript_snippet: We can verify that the owner pulled the receipt. We can verify what the person ate, that there is a receipt, and that it was paid for on a debit card.

claims.label: Kolvet Says the Host Said Hitler Was Great If He Stayed in Germany
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet says on the Kolvet/Neff show that the host had an event where she basically said Hitler was great if he had just stayed in Germany.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Kolvet's paraphrase with the full unedited clip and its context.
claims.transcript_snippet: Then she had that event where she basically said Hitler was great if he just would have stayed, you know, in uh Germany, stayed in Germany.

claims.label: Podcast Speaker Says She Became Obsessed With Jews in 2023 and 2024
claims.claim: A speaker on the Kolvet/Neff show says that in 2023 and 2024 the host became obsessed with Jews all the time.
claims.investigative_direction: Test the characterization against the host's actual 2023-2024 statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: 2023, 2024, she actually becomes obsessed with the Jews all the time.

claims.label: Podcast Speaker Links the Christchurch Shooter to the Host
